Each module has lessons and quiz questions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 15 added Training & Awareness feature. 12 modules seeded (7 GRC, 5 Platform). Each module has 2-5 lessons and a quiz with 3-7 questions. Quiz passing score is 70%. Progress tracked per user. Quiz correct answers stripped from GET /quiz endpoint to prevent cheating. All endpoints require authentication. Both admin and viewer roles can complete training. Module IDs: train-grc-001 to train-grc-007, train-plat-001 to train-plat-005. Lesson IDs: les-grc001-01 format. Quiz IDs: quiz-train-grc-001 format.
